title: [MAIN]-Bug 648518 Source Currency VAT Amount is zero on G/L Entry when posting sales invoice with Line Discount Deferral Code and Discount Posting is No Discounts
summary: Fixed an issue where Source Currency VAT Amount was incorrectly set to zero on G/L entries when posting sales invoices with line discounts, deferral codes, and discount posting set to No Discounts. The VAT amount is now calculated correctly across all scenarios.
key_points: Source Currency VAT Amount now calculates correctly when deferrals, line discounts, and No Discounts posting setting are combined
The fix ensures VAT calculation uses the formula (Unit Price - Discount) × VAT% in all cases
All Source Currency amounts now balance correctly across G/L entries
Test cases added to validate the fix across multiple localization layers
The posting routine in Sales Post Invoice codeunit was corrected to handle this edge case
quote: Source Currency VAT Amount is not zero when all three conditions are present.
